2607.23075.title: Traceable LLM Reasoning for Fake-Order Fraud Detection
2607.23075.paper_summary: Detecting fake-order fraud at scale remains a critical challenge for large online-to-offline (O2O) service platforms, as existing approaches often rely on expert-designed features, produce black-box decisions, and provide limited interpretability. To address these limitations, we propose DeepScrub, a reinforcement learning framework built upon large language models (LLMs) for fake-order fraud detection with traceable reasoning. DeepScrub introduces three innovations. First, a semantic unification module converts heterogeneous risk signals into textual descriptions that LLMs can understand. Second, continued pre-training on risk-control corpora injects domain knowledge, and task rewards jointly evaluate prediction correctness and reasoning quality. Third, the SUggest-REflect (SURE) mechanism incorporates expert feedback and model self-checking to iteratively refine reasoning paths. On a real-world fake-order fraud detection dataset, DeepScrub achieves a macro-F1 score of 85.3%, outperforming the best baseline by 2.7 percentage points. Our task-optimized 8B model further surpasses a 32B model, showing that domain adaptation can matter more than model scale in this setting. In a four-week live pilot, DeepScrub achieved 91.8% precision and 88.5% recall, improving over first-stage human reviewers by 16.6 and 38.8 percentage points. It reduced first-stage manual review workload by 94% and saved nearly one million RMB annually. These results show that DeepScrub improves fraud review accuracy, reduces first-stage review workload, and provides traceable evidence for production risk-review workflows.
2607.23075.paper_summary_zh: 偵測大規模的假訂單詐騙仍然是大型線上到線下 (O2O) 服務平台面臨的重大挑戰，因為現有的方法通常依賴專家設計的特徵，產生黑箱決策，並提供有限的可解釋性。為了解決這些限制，我們提出了 DeepScrub，一個基於大型語言模型 (LLMs) 的強化學習框架，用於假訂單詐騙檢測，並具備可追溯的推理。DeepScrub 引入了三項創新。首先，語義統一模塊將異質風險信號轉換為 LLMs 可以理解的文本描述。其次，對風險控制語料的持續預訓練注入了領域知識，並且任務獎勵共同評估預測正確性和推理質量。第三，SUggest-REflect (SURE) 機制結合了專家反饋和模型自我檢查，以迭代地完善推理路徑。在一個真實世界的假訂單詐騙檢測數據集中，DeepScrub 實現了 85.3% 的宏觀 F1 分數，超越了最佳基準 2.7 個百分點。我們的任務優化 8B 模型進一步超越了 32B 模型，顯示在這種情況下，領域適應可能比模型規模更為重要。在為期四週的現場試點中，DeepScrub 實現了 91.8% 的精確率和 88.5% 的召回率，分別比第一階段的人類審核者提高了 16.6 和 38.8 個百分點。它將第一階段的人工審核工作量減少了 94%，每年節省了近一百萬元人民幣。這些結果顯示，DeepScrub 提高了詐騙審核的準確性，減少了第一階段的審核工作量，並為生產風險審核工作流程提供了可追溯的證據。
